summary.intent: Restack the PR stack (#291/#292) after a denied force-push, then implement a time-based registry confirmation window (policy, config key, E157 error) as a new PR on top of the stack in the callisto repo.
summary.outcome: Replaced #291/#292 with rebuilt branches/PRs excluding #290's commit, implemented the confirmation window across graph crate, tests, snapshots, docs and changeset; local `just ci` passed and the change was committed and pushed with a PR opened on the stack.

repo: Work is done in a git worktree at .claude/worktrees/smoke-main of the callisto repo; crate of interest is crates/callisto-graph.
Release registry confirmation logic lives in commands/release/provider/policy.rs and registry.rs, with PyPI tests in registry/pypi_file_set_tests.rs and adapter tests in registry/tests.rs.

Adding a config key requires edits across config/raw.rs, config/resolve.rs, release/binding.rs, error.rs (E157 variant), plus docs (config.md, errors.md, releasing.md, architecture/release.md, specs/release.json).
Config changes produce insta snapshots that must be accepted, and pending snapshot files must be removed afterward.
Clippy-style lint rejects `let _ =` in tests; a lint also flagged duration.rs on first CI run.
`just ci` runs the full pipeline locally; its log's own `exit=0` is the success signal.
Changesets are added for user-facing changes via a script.
workflow: When force-push is denied, rebuild the stack on new branches and replace the PRs, relinking the stack, instead of retrying.
Batch multi-file edits via small Python/shell scripts in /tmp to apply and re-run formatting/tests quickly.
Run long local CI in the background while writing plan/docs files, then wait on the log.
A failed branch-creation command may still have created the branch; verify state before retrying.

friction: Force-push to the existing PR branches was denied, forcing a rebuild and replacement of PRs #291/#292.
Branch creation with tracking config failed partway, leaving the branch created but misconfigured.
Several test/lint iterations: struct literal updates, PyPI test helper signature change, `let _ =` lint, duration.rs lint failure in CI.
Plan file write to the shared plans directory needed a workaround (write locally then copy).
open_items: Replaced PRs #291/#292 supersede the originals; old PRs/branches may need cleanup.
Uncommitted Entire settings change (.entire/settings.json) was inspected but not resolved in this session.
Plan file NPM-PUBLISH-WAVE.md written for the npm publish wave work; follow-up PRs in that wave remain.
